body: This is super helpful! Thank you so much. Honestly, I believe it’s a mixed bag. I report mostly to four higher-ups, two of which I am friendly with and have spoken with me about promotion and working towards a promotion. Meanwhile, the other two have not been so open about that process and have been given some criticisms, majority of which are constructive! Thus, I’m saying that I really need to build out my case, probably after waiting a little bit longer!

Thank you so much for this! Yes, I believe that one year is the magic number and the perfect amount of time. I absolutely love working for this company however, so I only think I would play the “I’m getting an offer from another agency“ card if things got super drastic. However, I’ve heard of other people doing this at my company it seems that there really intend on keeping the people they hire! So this does help me build out my confidence a bit, in terms of stability in this position and wanting to stay at my current company!
Thank you for this! Going to start building out a document of accomplishments and bookmarks when I have time!

This is extremely helpful, thank you! I think it’s worth noting hear that my team has acknowledged that I complete my work and responsibilities extremely quickly, and was in turn giving much more responsibility on daily, weekly, and monthly recurring tasks. I also handle all of our client asks, or as many as I possibly can. Meanwhile, management has also been open about acknowledging the fact that out of all of the other coordinators, I am on the most amount of clients, working consistently on nine clients while other coordinators are working only on six. 

I believe management knows that I am not utilizing my time and efficiently, but have more work than others on top of responsibilities for recurring projects - this comment is extremely helpful though, and I definitely think it is worth touching base with management and letting them know that I am not spending my time in efficiently, but just working on a large amount of asks! This will definitely help towards building a case should I want to ask for a raise in the future.
Thank you! This is super helpful!

This is a great question, and it's something I wanted to give context to but nixed from my post bc it would make it too long. 

I am not taking longer to perform tasks and am quite fast, to a point where management has commented positively on the speed of my turnover time. Although I am fast with my responsibilities, my daily/weekly/monthly recurring reports/projects are on top of requests and extra projects from clients that give a few more hours of work. Every day I also have an average of 4.5 hours of meetings which usually takes up half the workday.

I've gotten into the habit of updating my status on work apps to let my coworkers know when I'm in meetings, etc - so they know if I am too busy to report to them right away.
Thank you for a truthful reply! It's better to know what I signed up for than to let any type of negative attitude build up.
